story_text:
Limited-Time Offer: This special offer is available for one week only! Back before November 13 at 9:00 AM PST to enjoy the discounted price.
## OPEN. PLAY. SING. ANYWHERE.
## TAKE THE STAGE WHEREVER YOU GO
All-in-one karaoke made to go wherever you do.
## ONE MACHINE. A WHOLE NEW PARTY.
Sing, play, and light up the night for every celebration.
## FAMILY MOMENTS. LASTING MEMORIES.
Turn everyday family moments into unforgettable shared experiences.
## SING BETTER
Clear vocals and powerful sound, tuned for karaoke.
## CAPTURE & SHARE
Record your performances and share the moments you love.
## CREATE MORE
Create songs and videos with built-in Al tools.
## WHY CHOOSE SINGCORE S1 / S1 PRO?
## SEE HOW SINGCORE STACKS UP
## MORE THAN TRADITIONAL KARAOKE
## PROVEN CROWDFUNDING TRACK RECORD
Born from Ultimea’s passion for innovative home entertainment and backed by the Kickstarter legacy of Ultimea Skywave X100 Dual.
## EXPERIENCES FROM REAL USERS
## WHAT THE WORLD IS SAYING
@unboxtherapy: This thing is a lot of fun! I really love how integrated everything is — it takes the friction away from setting anything up, and you just pack it, grab the handle, and you’re ready to go. It’s fun for all!
@HomemakingwithRoma: We had such a lovely time trying this together, and I can't wait to bring it out when our friends come over. The screen, speakers, camera, battery, and smart system are all built into this one unit with two wireless microphones included. Everything comes together here, keeping the setup simple.
@ganma.ch.caraudio: 持ち運びできて音が良くてカラオケもできてマイクもついてる。これね普通にね、例えばその会社の備品とかであっても、めちゃくちゃいいんじゃないかなと。そんな時にこれがあったら、そのままカラオケ大会が始められる。 (It’s portable, sounds great, and comes with microphones for karaoke. I think it would be a great addition to an office, too. With this around, you could turn an ordinary company gathering into a karaoke party.)
@JonnEnguero: Napakaliit, very portable. So approve sa atin. Yes, approve sa amin. This is a very good product for family, for everyone na gustong magenjoy. (It’s compact and very portable. We definitely approve! This is a great product for families and anyone who loves to have fun.)
@MunkTVDOMUNK: ถ้าผมให้คะแนน overall ทั้งหมดผมก็ให้ประมาณแบบ 8 เต็ม 10 ... Solid Karaoke Device AI Singing Machine ที่ผมว่าน่าสนใจมากทีเดียว. (Overall, I’d give it around 8 out of 10. It’s a solid karaoke device—an AI singing machine that I find really interesting.)
## ENGINEERED FOR SEAMLESS PERFORMANCE
## DEDICATED AI PROCESSING
A built-in NPU delivers up to 6 TOPS of dedicated AI processing power, providing the computing foundation for intelligent singing analysis, voice recognition, image processing, and AI content creation.
## SMOOTH, RESPONSIVE PERFORMANCE
Powered by an octa-core CPU running at up to 2.2GHz and backed by 4GB RAM, Singcore delivers up to 62,000 DMIPS of computing performance for smooth app navigation, responsive controls, and seamless entertainment.
## SMOOTH GRAPHICS PERFORMANCE
The Mali-G52 MC3 GPU delivers smooth graphics and responsive visuals for gaming, video streaming, and everyday entertainment apps.
## YOUR PERSONAL CINEMA, ANYWHERE.
Enjoy movies and TV shows wherever you go. With support for up to 4K video processing at 120fps, Singcore brings smooth playback and immersive entertainment to any space.
## PREMIUM-GRADE BATTERY CELLS
Built with premium-grade cells for enhanced safety, high efficiency with less heat, and up to 3x the lifespan of conventional batteries.
## PREMIUM HARDWARE. SUPERIOR EXPERIENCE.
## THREE-WAY ACOUSTIC DESIGN
With dedicated tweeters, full-range drivers, and woofers, it delivers smooth highs, clear vocals, and deep, full-bodied bass for every performance.
## POWER UP EVERY PARTY
With 510W peak power, feel every beat, own every chorus, and keep the party going.
## FAST. FAR. ALL NIGHT.
The 5.8GHz wireless microphones keep your voice clear and natural, with up to 30 meters (98 feet) of wireless range and 30 hours of battery life for longer singing sessions.
## BUILT-IN 2K WIDE-ANGLE CAMERA
Capture your performances in clear detail with a wide-angle view of 78° or more. The built-in camera makes recording effortless, with no external equipment or complicated setup. S1 features a 5MP camera, while S1 Pro offers an 8MP camera.
## ONE APP. MORE POSSIBILITIES.
## STAGE-READY MICROPHONE EFFECTS
Adjust reverb and echo to create a vocal effect that feels made for your own stage.
## FLEXIBLE EQ CUSTOMIZATION
Choose from 4 quick EQ modes or fine-tune each frequency band to shape your sound your way.
## 121 PRO-TUNED EQ PRESETS
Find the perfect sound for your favorite music styles with 121 professionally tuned EQ presets.
## CONTROL & CREATE FROM YOUR PHONE
Take control of your Singcore experience, adjust settings, and create music and videos right from the Singcore App.
## MAKE EVERY MOMENT UNIQUELY YOURS
From birthdays to parties with friends, create personalized songs with AI that make every celebration unforgettable.
## THE SONG ENDS. THE MEMORY LIVES ON.
Capture your performance with the built-in camera, transform it with AI Film in the Singcore app, and create a one-of-a-kind music video ready to share.
## SEE THE MAGIC OF AI CREATION
Turn simple ideas into original songs and transform your recorded performances into personalized music videos with AI Film.
## CAN'T FIND A KARAOKE VERSION OF YOUR FAVORITE SONG?
Turn almost any favorite song into a karaoke-ready track with vocal removal—right from the Singcore App or with a single tap of the mic button.
## BUILT AROUND YOUR LIFESTYLE
## EXPLORE THE COMMUNITY STAGE
Join online sing-offs, share your performances, and connect with other singers who love to sing, create, and compete.
## SHARE YOUR FAMILY MOMENTS
Create a shared family space to manage profiles, view updates, and keep every singing moment in one place.
## SINGCORE S1 PRO AT 2026 IFA
## IFA 2026 INNOVATION AWARD
Recognized at IFA 2026 for its innovative all-in-one design, Singcore S1 Pro brings karaoke, entertainment, and Al-powered creativity together in one device.
## WATCH SINGCORE AT IFA 2026
## PERKS WE OFFER
## OPTIONAL ADD-ON
*Redemption Method: After the crowdfunding campaign ends, buyers will receive a redemption code via private message based on the package they purchased. The code can be redeemed in the Singcore device app. The redemption period is from December 2026 to December 2027.
*Estimated usage is for reference only. Actual credit consumption may vary by AI feature and creation settings. Each example represents an alternative use of the credit pack.
Unused credits are eligible for a refund; once any credits have been used, the pack is non-refundable.
Credits can also be used in the mobile app.
Cloud storage is valid for 1 month, with content viewable for up to 12 months. If you don't subscribe via the app after 12 months, we'll notify you and may delete your stored content if you don't renew.
## SHIPPING POLICY
Shipping Notes: We do not ship to PO Box, APO, FPO, or DPO addresses.
European Union: An additional $30 shipping fee applies to island regions. For other extremely remote areas, an additional shipping fee of $30–$100 may apply depending on the delivery address. Backers in these areas will also be responsible for customs clearance.
Canada: Additional shipping fees may apply to extremely remote areas.
Alaska, Hawaii, and U.S. Territories: Please select the United States as your shipping destination when pledging. An additional $100 shipping fee will be charged after the campaign ends, and backers will be responsible for customs clearance.
Mexico and Brazil: Standard shipping typically takes approximately 75–100 days.
The exact additional shipping fees will depend on the specific delivery address and may vary from the estimates above. The final shipping cost will be communicated to backers via private message after the crowdfunding campaign ends.
*We currently do not ship to the following countries/regions: China (CN), India (IN), Russia (RU), Belarus (BY), Colombia (CO), Nigeria (NG), Gibraltar (GI), Moldova (MD), New Caledonia (NC), Ukraine (UA), Serbia (RS), Uzbekistan (UZ), Iran (IR), Israel (IL), and Turkey (TR).

risks: Like any new tech product, the Singcore S1 Series may face unexpected production or delivery challenges. With our experienced team and trusted manufacturing partners, we’re confident in delivering on time and at the highest quality. If any issues arise, we promise to keep you fully informed with timely updates. Thank you for your support and for joining us on this journey.

faq.q: When will the Kickstarter campaign launch?
faq.a: The campaign is currently planned to launch on Nov 3. The exact date may shift slightly depending on final launch preparations. Please keep an eye on your email for the confirmed launch date.

faq.q: How long will the Kickstarter campaign last?
faq.a: The campaign is currently planned to run for approximately 30 days.
The $9.9 pre-launch deposit is a limited-time offer that allows you to unlock $100 savings for the Singcore Kickstarter campaign.

faq.q: When can I reserve with the $9.9 pre-order deposit?
faq.a: You can place your $9.9 pre-order deposit on the Singcore official website before the project launch. Limited spots are available, so we recommend reserving early before they sell out.

faq.q: Can I use the $100 savings benifit directly on Kickstarter?
faq.a: No. The savings cannot be applied directly at Kickstarter checkout because the Singcore website and Kickstarter are separate platforms.

faq.q: How do I redeem my $100 savings from $9.9 deposit?
faq.a: Before the Kickstarter campaign ends, email support@singcore.ai with a screenshot of your $9.90 deposit confirmation showing your order number, along with your Kickstarter backer number. Once the campaign ends and your pledge is successfully charged, we’ll process your $100 refund through Kickstarter within 7 days.

faq.q: Is the Singcore S1 Series available for worldwide purchase?
faq.a: We plan to ship to most countries and regions worldwide. Please refer to the Shipping Policy on our Kickstarter campaign page for the full list of supported destinations.

faq.q: What is the difference between Singcore S1 and Singcore S1 Pro?
faq.a: The Singcore S1 comes with 64GB of storage and a 5MP camera, while the Singcore S1 Pro offers 128GB of storage and an 8MP camera.

faq.q: When will I receive my product after backing on Kickstarter?
faq.a: Based on our current fulfillment plan, most backers who successfully complete their payments can expect to receive their products between January and February 2027. Delivery to certain remote areas may take longer. Please refer to our Kickstarter campaign page and future updates for the latest delivery information.

faq.q: Is the Singcore S1 Series available for worldwide purchase?
faq.a: We plan to ship to most countries and regions worldwide. Please refer to the Shipping Policy on our Kickstarter campaign page for the full list of supported destinations.

faq.q: How much is the shipping fee for the supported product?
faq.a:
Shipping fees vary by destination. Please refer to the Shipping Policy on our Kickstarter campaign page for details.
Additional shipping fees may apply to certain remote areas. If applicable, we will notify backers via Kickstarter direct message after the campaign ends. The final additional charges will be based on the amount communicated.

faq.q: What is the warranty period for the original product?
faq.a: Our warranty period is determined according to the laws of each country. You can find the detailed terms on the After-Sales section of our website.

faq.q: Are the Super Early Bird, Early Bird, and Late Pledge offers limited in quantity and time?
faq.a: Yes, all three offers are limited in both quantity and availability. Super Early Bird is especially limited, so we recommend pledging as soon as the campaign launches to secure the best price.

faq.q: Can I add Add-ons after selecting a reward?
faq.a: Yes. You can simply edit your original pledge to add Add-ons while the campaign is live.

faq.q: What is the Expedited Shipping add-on?
faq.a:
Our first batch of products is expected to be ready in December 2026, with standard shipping deliveries estimated between January and February 2027.
For backers hoping to receive their orders before Christmas, we offer faster shipping for an additional $69, with estimated delivery by December 23.
